subject: Next steps: Hosted pilot + quickstart & rate-limit profile
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps: Hosted pilot + quickstart & rate-limit profile

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap from our side and a suggested onramp so we can get you evaluating Hosted as the primary path: 

Summary of what we heard
- Preference: want hosted API to start (no infra management) but need to validate SOC 2 controls and data retention for payment data.
- Traffic: typical interactive flows; you estimated ~30 req/s steady per region with ~3–5 minute bursts up to 100–120 req/s during heavy checkout periods.
- SLOs: desire p99 < 250ms for short prompts; can tolerate slightly higher for long generation.
- Network: will require static IP allowlist and egress details.

Proposed hosted pilot quickstart (1–2 weeks)
1) Pilot org + API key: we spin up a sandbox org and give you an API key scoped to test models/endpoints.
2) Baseline rate limits: default trial rate is 60 req/s; we can temporarily raise to 150 req/s for the pilot (no code changes needed).
3) Endpoints: you can use the standard chat/generate endpoints (see attached quickstart PDF and link below).
4) Security: we’ll provide SOC 2 summary and our data retention policy; we can add IP allowlist entries for your CIDR blocks.
5) Kickoff: 30–45min onboarding call to create test keys, confirm traffic profile, and run a smoke test.

Attachments: redwood_hosted_quickstart.pdf (quickstart + sample requests)
Links: https://docs.redwood.com/hosted/quickstart

Ask for you: can you confirm the steady / burst numbers above and share the CIDR(s) for IP allowlist? Also confirm whether you want us to provision the temporary increased rate for the pilot.

If Hosted doesn't meet isolation needs after pilot, we can scope Dedicated or Private VPC. I’ve cc’d Marissa to loop in Dedicated capacity options early if you want a parallel path.

Thanks — happy to schedule the onboarding; I have availability Mon/Tue afternoon PT.

—
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
https://redwood.com

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finpay.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@finpay.com
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps: Hosted pilot + quickstart & rate-limit profile

Hi Camila —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the traffic numbers below are accurate for our initial pilot:
- Typical steady: 25–35 req/s (US region)
- Peak bursts: up to ~120 req/s for windows of 2–5 minutes during payment rushes

A few clarifying questions before we kick off the pilot:
1) Rate limits: we appreciate the temporary raise to 150 req/s. Will that be enforced per API key or per account? We may need it scoped to a single test key.
2) IP allowlist: we will provide a small set of CIDR blocks for our test environment. Can you confirm how often IP list changes can be applied (immediate vs 24 hours)?
3) Data handling: our security team attached a short questionnaire — can you confirm if you can complete the SOC 2 summary + data retention answers within 48 hours?
4) Egress: do you have recommendations for whitelisting egress domains and whether responses will flow through Redwood-controlled IPs or per-region egress?

We’re leaning Hosted for speed of integration; Dedicated would be considered if we need VPC-only traffic for production. For now, pilot on Hosted makes sense.

Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Integrations, FinPay
alex.johnson@finpay.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

Alex —

Looping in on a couple of operational items we can commit to for the pilot:
- Rate limit scope: we can apply the temporary 150 req/s uplift at the API key level for the pilot. If you later want account-wide increases, we can evaluate after the pilot metrics.
- IP allowlist updates: we can add CIDRs within one business hour for pilot requests submitted via our secure portal; emergency updates can be done faster via our ops chat.
- Egress & regions: Hosted responses originate from our regional endpoints; for the US region responses will come from Redwood-managed IPs. We’ll provide an egress IP list you can whitelist for the pilot.

I’ve attached a pilot DPA draft (pilot-dpa-draft.docx) with limited-scope language for the evaluation. Legal can turn it into a full DPA if/when you move to Dedicated or Private.

Camila — if you want, we can provision the sandbox org and a test key today so Alex’s team can run integration tests tomorrow. I’ll also ask Security to expedite the SOC 2 summary for FinPay’s questionnaire.

—
